description: An unknown rootId on the overview door is the SAME typed refusal the inbox carries (ErrInboxScope, -31926 — one scope convention, SV1): the mission plane never invents a second way to say 'that tree does not exist live here', and an overview of nothing is never returned for a typo.

data.what: the inbox scope named a component this store does not carry live (rootId "cmp-does-not-exist")
data.means: an empty inbox would have looked like 'nothing needs you' — this refusal says the scope itself was the unknown thing, so an empty list can never be a lie about a typo
data.todo: check the id against `component.list` (archived components are out of scope like unknown ones), or call inbox.list/inbox.summary with no rootId to see every tree
